component.name: Fjord Files
component.summary: Browse and manage files on Linux

description.p: Fjord Files is a development fork of Dux Files and a native Linux file manager with tabs, split views, file previews, and asynchronous file operations.
Adds paused, muted video previews with thumbnails, clip selection, and fullscreen playback. Adds an Umbriel blur-strength control and improves search and path field interaction.

Adds adjustable liquid-glass styling with a live preview, independent opacity controls, and an optional compositor-managed background blur setting. Refines the settings layout, tab overview, search-field clicks, and Fjord branding.
First Fjord Files preview release with native Linux file management, tabs, split views, previews, and asynchronous file operations.
